messages.subject: Executive application | Government relations, ESG and aviation stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Bangkok Airways Recruitment Team,

I am submitting my executive profile for consideration across Bangkok Airways roles where government relations, ESG, corporate affairs and stakeholder strategy support regional growth.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and executive stakeholder strategy. My institutional interfaces include civil aviation authorities alongside mining, environmental, energy, labour, standards, revenue and public-security agencies.

I bring practical experience coordinating approvals, official engagements, remote-site logistics, aviation-related operating requirements and cross-functional commitments in a complex environment. I also support energy-transition and carbon-governance work, giving me a strong basis for sustainability and institutional strategy in aviation.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional mandates across Government Relations, Corporate Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships or country-facing leadership. I am open to international relocation and have a 30-day notice period.

My attached CV is tailored to Bangkok Airways. I would value a discussion with the relevant senior business or talent leader.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
